tenant_delegation._comment: Lab 35 (SC-300 1.1/1.2). Role facts follow Microsoft Learn 'Least privileged roles by task', 'Privileged roles and permissions', 'Assign roles with administrative unit scope' and 'Restricted management administrative units' as read in 2026. Re-check the 'privileged' labels against Learn before an exam: Microsoft adds roles and labels regularly.

reset_password_and_sign_out.description: reset non-admin passwords and force sign-out (invalidate refresh tokens)

reset_mfa_methods.description: reset or re-register authentication methods for non-admin users

manage_groups.description: create and manage groups and group settings

assign_licenses.description: assign and remove product licences on users and groups

register_apps.description: create app registrations when 'Users can register applications' is set to No

configure_enterprise_app.description: configure single sign-on for one enterprise application

update_app_credentials.description: rotate the secrets and certificates of one app registration

manage_conditional_access.description: create and change Conditional Access policies

plan_definitions.TENANT: assign the role at tenant (directory-wide) scope
plan_definitions.ADMINISTRATIVE_UNIT: assign the role scoped to one administrative unit
plan_definitions.OBJECT: assign the role scoped to one specific object, such as a single application
plan_definitions.CUSTOM_ROLE: build a custom role with only the listed permissions
plan_definitions.ESCALATE: make no assignment; send the request to the identity team

finding_definitions.PRIVILEGED_ROLE_ON_GUEST: an external guest holds a privileged directory role
finding_definitions.GLOBAL_ADMIN_EXCESS: the tenant has more Global Administrators than policy allows, or too few emergency access accounts
finding_definitions.RESTRICTED_AU_MEMBER: the admin must manage members of a restricted management administrative unit without a role scoped to it
finding_definitions.ASSIGNMENT_TOO_BROAD: the role or its scope is wider than the job needs
finding_definitions.DYNAMIC_GROUP_RULE: a dynamic membership rule includes or excludes the wrong users

concepts.administrative unit: A container of users, groups or devices that lets a role be assigned for just those objects instead of the whole tenant.
concepts.restricted management administrative uni: An administrative unit whose members can be changed only by admins assigned at that unit's scope, not by tenant-wide admins.
concepts.least privilege: Give each admin the smallest role at the smallest scope that still lets them do their job.
concepts.role scope: The boundary a role assignment applies to: the whole tenant, one administrative unit, or one object such as an app.
concepts.custom role: A role you build from selected Microsoft Entra permissions when no built-in role is narrow enough.
concepts.emergency access account: A cloud-only break-glass Global Administrator kept for when normal admins are locked out.
concepts.dynamic membership rule: An expression on user attributes, such as department or country, that adds and removes group members automatically.
concepts.role-assignable group: A group created with isAssignableToRole set, which can hold role assignments and must use assigned (not dynamic) membership.
